Lemma
[global uniqueness of geodesics]

Source: petersen:page-0189 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-local-uniqueness

1. ch5:5.2.4Let $I_1,I_2$ be open intervals with $t_0\in I_1\cap I_2$. If $c_1:I_1\to M$ and $c_2:I_2\to M$ are geodesics with $c_1(t_0)=c_2(t_0)$ and $\dot c_1(t_0)=\dot c_2(t_0)$, then $c_1|_{I_1\cap I_2}=c_2|_{I_1\cap I_2}$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch5-global-uniqueness \sketch Let $A$ be the set where positions and velocities agree. It is nonempty and closed, while local uniqueness in a chart makes it open. Connectedness of $I_1\cap I_2$ gives $A=I_1\cap I_2$.

□
